supplemental_primitives.economic_mechanism: HBM keyword or product specification establishes profile only, not customer demand or booked capacity.
positive_predicates: target directly identifies an HBM product generation
partial_predicates: product performance or density is disclosed
counter_predicates: product exists but qualification or customer adoption is not established

supplemental_primitives.economic_mechanism: Customer qualification changes execution confidence but is not itself a sale.
positive_predicates: current target product passed named or attributable customer qualification
counter_predicates: qualification lag, failure, or redesign remains open

supplemental_primitives.economic_mechanism: Shipment, mass production, or disclosed HBM revenue mix bridges product evidence toward realized economics.
positive_predicates: current target shipment, mass production, or HBM revenue mix is directly disclosed
counter_predicates: delay, low mix, or customer dependency limits conversion
unsupported_predicates: sold-out capacity unless booked status is stated

supplemental_primitives.economic_mechanism: Realized revenue and operating profit show economic conversion, while the HBM causal bridge must remain explicit.
positive_predicates: target actual revenue or operating profit is tied to HBM, memory mix, or realized ASP
partial_predicates: record result and ASP are disclosed but HBM attribution is incomplete
counter_predicates: profit is driven by unrelated segments or one-offs

supplemental_primitives.economic_mechanism: Margin and free-cash conversion determine whether HBM economics survive capex and working-capital needs.
positive_predicates: target margin or FCF improvement is explicitly tied to HBM economics
partial_predicates: operating profit improves but cash conversion is undisclosed
counter_predicates: capex, working capital, or conventional memory drag absorbs profit

supplemental_primitives.economic_mechanism: Conventional DRAM/NAND weakness can cap HBM-led earnings conversion.
positive_predicates: current target directly reports conventional memory drag
partial_predicates: industry memory softness with target exposure
counter_predicates: broad memory recovery offsets the drag

supplemental_primitives.economic_mechanism: Capacity expansion can support shipment but also relax scarcity and create oversupply risk.
positive_predicates: funded target capacity plan has a current schedule and demand bridge
counter_predicates: rapid industry expansion threatens pricing or utilization

supplemental_primitives.economic_mechanism: Packaging or substrate exposure is an adjacent profile signal, not direct target HBM customer economics.
positive_predicates: direct package or substrate exposure is documented
partial_predicates: industry HBM packaging demand is visible
counter_predicates: target is only an indirect beneficiary
